findings: GPU class mismatch: Fireworks ran on B200/H200; SageMaker on g4dn/g5 (T4/A10G 16-96GB), forcing smaller batches, contexts, and rollouts.
Hyperparameter deltas forced by smaller GPUs: ORena SFT batch 4/32->1/4 and max context 65536->2048; GoEmotions SFT max context 8192->512; RL rollouts 8->4.
ORena SFT LoRA rank 64->32: 9B bf16 SFT OOM'd on a single 24GB A10G (~200MB over); rank 32/64 + expandable_segments made it fit (still bf16, no quantization).

RL runs completed but did not learn (reward=0): Qwen3/Qwen3.5 thinking mode made every completion run to max_completion_length, so reward stayed 0. Fireworks disabled thinking; the SageMaker launch did not.
ORena RL base model differs: SageMaker ran GRPO on Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B directly; Fireworks can only RL qwen3-vl-8b-instruct.
Data source & format diverge: SageMaker read from s3://stanford-train-data (frame-file JPEG paths + parquet index), not the byte-identical canonical data/ files or Fireworks' base64-inline JSONL.
Optimizer differs: SageMaker used the TRL default AdamW; Fireworks used AdamW 8-bit with cosine decay + 10% warmup.
ORena reward semantics differ: SageMaker orena_reward.py gives partial credit (micro-F1 / token-F1 / exact); Fireworks reward is exact-match after normalization. GoEmotions reward (Jaccard) matches.

notes.cost: estimated_cost_usd = on-demand list price x billable seconds (TrainingTimeInSeconds), excl. EBS/egress. Prices: ml.g4dn.xlarge $0.526/hr, ml.g5.xlarge $1.006/hr, ml.g5.2xlarge $1.212/hr, ml.g5.12xlarge $5.672/hr. Unlike Fireworks managed RL, SageMaker surfaces billable time for every job, so all four carry a cost estimate.
notes.dataset_cap: dataset_size is the demo-budget cap (max_train_samples/max_samples launch hyperparameters: 256-5000), not the full dataset size Fireworks used (2000-43410).
notes.rl_reward_zero: Both GRPO runs completed 0-reward: Qwen3/Qwen3.5 'thinking mode' generated <think> blocks that exhausted max_completion_length (clipped_ratio=1, kl~0). start/final score fields are 0.0 and no meaningful curve is recorded.
notes.orena_sft_oom: Attempts 1-3 failed (pyarrow mixed-content -> DataParallel device mismatch -> CUDA OOM). Attempt 4 succeeded at rank 32/64 + single-GPU + expandable_segments (train_loss 1.494).
